value.title: Recognise the Codex 0.164 footer with a session title
value.summary: pij never delivers to Codex 0.164 seats because the footer gained a trailing session-title segment the parser rejects.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: 2026-10-24: pij-cold-quelea sent a pointer to pij-public-anglerfish (Codex 0.164, pane %100). Receipt: `queued — unrecognized — cold-check: clear`; it never arrived. Cause: Codex 0.164's footer is `GPT-6.1-Sol high · ~/github/novels · Adopt seat and wait`. is_codex_footer (crates/harnesses/src/composer.rs:201) takes only the text after the LAST `·` and expects a path, so the footer is rejected, the composer is never recognised, and the pointer worker retries `unrecognized` forever. The same rsplit drives readiness and model/cwd extraction in adapter.rs, so the fix must be one segment parser for all of them.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Changing the interaction gate or retry policy.

value.claim: Codex 0.164 composer recognised. A pane whose footer is `<model> <effort> · <cwd> · <session title>` (live example, pane %100, 2026-10-24: `GPT-6.1-Sol high · ~/github/novels · Adopt seat and wait`) is recognised by crates/harnesses/src/composer.rs is_codex_footer and the composer finder, so an idle empty composer submits and a non-empty draft is held as composer-busy, not `unrecognized`. The older two-segment footers (fixture 2026-09-08-codex-v0.153.4-pane-4409.txt, absolute and ~/ paths, the context/tokens variants) stay recognised.

One parser, segment-based. is_codex_footer and the model and cwd extraction in crates/harnesses/src/adapter.rs (readiness ~278, observed_model ~350, observed_cwd ~370) share ONE segment parser: split on `·`, model+effort from the first segment, cwd from the segment that is a path, extra trailing segments ignored. observed_cwd returns the expanded `~/github/novels`, never the session title; observed_model returns the model. A session title that itself contains `·` or looks like a path is covered by a test and handled conservatively (no false cwd).

Proof. A fixture recorded from a Codex 0.164 pane (bottom lines only: prompt, footer, hint line; no transcript content) is added under crates/harnesses/tests/fixtures/. New tests are RED on main 7babd01 (quoted) and green on the branch; one mutation receipt (revert to rsplit_once → a named test red → restore). cargo test -p pij-harnesses, clippy -D warnings and fmt pass; GitHub CI green on the exact head; anything not run is NOT RUN.

Docs and delivery note. docs/how (wherever Codex readiness or composer recognition is documented; search first) names the session-title segment. The PR body says whether messages already queued as `unrecognized` to a Codex seat deliver on their own once the fixed daemon runs (cite the retry path in crates/daemon/src/pointer/worker.rs ~374), or says precisely why not.

value.title: Parse the Codex footer by segment
value.brief: One phase: fixture, red tests, one segment parser for recognition/readiness/model/cwd, mutation receipt, docs, PR. CS 2.
